text:
[RFCS.17.4] Container legality has **one** normative home, and it is this clause.

Under [RFCS.16.1] there is one registry over one field-number space, so which container
may carry an atom is a **column of one table** rather than a property of two alphabets.
[RDSC.8.8] cites this clause for the rule and states only what is local to the DSC
grammar: that a production may name a DSC-legal terminal and no other. Membership itself
is a query over the container-legality column, which is gate-checkable where a prose list
is not.
